text: The package read the bait AWS credentials file, took the honeytoken aws_access_key_id out of the sandbox, and attempted network calls to the EC2 metadata address, AWS STS, api.github.com and registry.npmjs.org. It also spawned curl to try to use a GitHub token against the GitHub API and probed npm with stolen credentials, and it wrote a commitlint shim into node_modules/.bin outside its own package. That pattern is credential theft and token abuse, which is why the verdict is CRITICAL. Do not merge or install this package; treat any real credentials present on machines that ran it as compromised and rotate them, and check whether the .bin/commitlint file was created in your tree.
